linkedin.text:
🚨 You spend 30 minutes tweaking an AI image prompt, hit generate, and the layout is completely wrong.

You adjust the wording. Still wrong. You try caps, brackets, reordering. Still breaks.

Why? Because prose-style prompts don't give you structured control over hierarchy, copy placement, or visual composition. You're hoping the model guesses your intent.

GPT-Image2 turns scattered prompt examples into composable templates:
✅ 538 reverse-engineered cases organized by visual category
✅ 20 industrial templates with atomic slots for subject, lighting, layout, and materials
✅ Designed for agents, batch workflows, and production automation

Instead of rewriting prompts from scratch every time, you pull a UI template, swap the subject and copy, and generate 1,000 consistent posters without layout drift.

⭐ 1,800+ stars on GitHub and growing fast.

Search "freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2" on GitHub to grab the templates.

Have you tried structured prompt systems for batch generation, or are you still writing prose prompts one at a time?
